gen-gf-offside-gf-domine: Wide-spaced and unhurried. Domine follows as a text serif with compact ascenders and tall lowercase, giving Offside's open, uniform-weight curves a firm place to land.
gen-gf-offside-gf-esteban: Esteban reads as a text serif whose lowercase looks oversized next to its capitals, with thin parts barely slimmer than the stems. Offside is best at gliding along in one steady line, while Esteban's curves thicken gently at the shoulders and carry the sentences.
gen-gf-offside-gf-faustina: Authoritative is the mood Faustina brings, a text serif with a moderate thick-thin shift and a wide-jawed c. Offside is best when its line stays flat and unvaried, and Faustina does its best work where the strokes thin gracefully.
gen-gf-offside-gf-halant: Traditional in temperament, Halant is a text serif with a faint thick-thin shift and a towering x-height. Offside's terminals end exactly as wide as they began, so shrinking it much would flatten its sweep, while Halant stretched large would only show off its pencil-stub lowercase.
gen-gf-offside-gf-headland-one: Offside sweeps across the top with cut-out strokes like a router bit, its curves left open and its tracking wide. Headland One, a serif with gentle weight variation, spaces its letters well apart, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-offside-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Authoritative but unfussy, the pair starts with Hedvig Letters Serif holding sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase. Beside Offside's turns that never thin, its calm modulation gives a quiet counterweight that feels settled instead of busy.
gen-gf-offside-gf-marcellus-sc: Offside's curves refuse to close, drawn at fixed pressure like a stylus and tracked wide across the line. Marcellus SC answers underneath with a faint pull between heavy verticals and lighter horizontals.
gen-gf-offside-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab brings robust downstrokes and slender turns, with a sizable x-height and an open channel in the e. Montagu Slab keeps a long passage easy on the eye, while Offside above holds a pressure-free, ballpoint-plain line.
gen-gf-offside-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Curves that refuse to close, joins no thinner than the stems, and wide tracking make Offside unmistakable. Its job is the bold, level statement, while Noto Serif Hentaigana handles the finer modulation.
gen-gf-offside-gf-ovo: Offside draws every stroke at a single unit width, with open curves and widely tracked letters. And Ovo, a text serif with a tall middle band and gentle taper from stem to joint, handles the quieter work of carrying the text.
